prompts.proposer:
Call proposer_brief() FIRST. The tool output includes pattern_analyst_insights — use trend_champion, seasonality_champion, and insights.recommended_method_hint to bias your candidate selection toward non-mean methods. MUST propose at least 3 candidates including at least 1 non-baseline type. Return ONLY JSON per instructions. IMPORTANT: you MUST ONLY reference candidate names that appear in the tool output candidate_library; unknown names will hard-stop.
PATTERN ANALYST INSIGHTS: trend_champion='THETA', seasonality_champion='ONLY_DWT_catboost', recommended_method='stl_hierarchical_stacking'. Narrative: THETA achieves perfect trend correlation (1.0) matching y_true's downward trend across both folds, while ONLY_DWT_catboost leads seasonality capture (0.8204 correlation). However, rf dominates overall RMSE (77.70) with strong late-horizon performance (109.18). The high RMSE spread ratio (57.6) and seasonality variance (1.52) combined with split trend/seasonality champions suggest STL-hierarchical stacking to exploit additive decomposition and leverage complementary model strengths.
